subject: Marine Works - Dredging - Fraser River, Strait of Georgia
text:
Marine Works - Dredging - Fraser River, Strait of Georgia
The RIVERFLOW SPIRIT will be conducting maintenance dredging within the main channel of the Fraser River from KM-2 to KM-35.  Disposal activities will be undertaken within the In-River Disposal Site (49 11.753N 122 55.043W), and at the Sand Heads Spoil Site (49 06.727N 123 11.906W).
Hours of Operation:  24 hours.
Monitoring VHF Channel 74.
All vessels are requested to make contact upon approach.
